tokens.name: bg-void
tokens.usage: Untinted window frame (no workspace color yet, e.g. a fresh profile). With a workspace active, accent-<n>-void takes its place. Never put controls straight on it, only the page card and the sidebar.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Untinted sidebar, header strip and internal pages. With a workspace active, accent-<n>-base takes its place.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Floating and lifted surfaces: the web-page card, the active tab, Command Center, menus, the address pill, toasts. Never tinted by the workspace: it is what stands out of the colored window.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Untinted hover and pressed fill for rows and quiet buttons. With a workspace active, accent-<n>-hover takes its place.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Untinted hairlines that only separate. With a workspace active, accent-<n>-line takes its place. Decorative: carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls a person must find (inputs, toggles off, checkboxes). Holds 3:1 on bg-base and bg-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-void, bg-base, bg-raised and bg-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: URLs under titles, shortcut hints, captions, inactive icons. 4.5:1+ on every bg-* token in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and their labels only (disabled buttons, the Forward button with no history). Below 4.5:1 on purpose, as WCAG exempts disabled UI: never for placeholders, hints or any text a person needs to read; those take ink-muted.

tokens.name: ket
tokens.usage: The brand violet from the |z⟩ icon: the logo, the cover, and the default workspace accent (accent-violet aliases it). Components never paint ket directly: they use the active workspace's accent.

tokens.name: on-ket
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a ket fill (the default accent).

tokens.name: ket-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of ket; the soft fill of the default accent (accent-violet-soft).

tokens.name: zing
tokens.usage: Acid lime: Zitter's one extravagance. Fills only, at most one per view: the Zing button, the tremor loader, the split-view handle while dragged. Always with on-zing text. Same in every theme and workspace, never a workspace color.

tokens.name: on-zing
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a zing fill (15.8:1).

tokens.name: zing-ink
tokens.usage: Zing as text on bg-raised (a 'nowe' tag). Light theme darkens it to stay legible.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Lime in Noc, ink in Papier, so it stays apart from every workspace accent. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success and secure states (download finished, HTTPS). Teal, not green, so it never pairs with danger on hue alone. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings (mixed content, download paused). Text on bg-base and bg-raised. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors (close all, certificate error). Orange, readable on bg-base and bg-raised. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Veil over the window behind a Dialog or the Command Center. Never under text that must be read.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Workspace accent „Fiolet”: fill of the primary button, toggle on, address-pill edit ring, workspace dot, page loading bar. Mapped to --accent by [data-accent="violet"].

tokens.name: on-accent-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent-violet fill (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for accent-violet: selected Command Center row, pressed icon button, active workspace chip. Carries accent-violet-ink text.

tokens.name: accent-violet-ink
tokens.usage: accent-violet as text or a thin mark (selected row label, links, audio icon) on bg-base, bg-raised, bg-hover and accent-violet-soft, 4.5:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-violet-void
tokens.usage: Window tint „Fiolet”: the window frame behind the sidebar and the page card. Replaces bg-void under [data-accent="violet"]. ink and ink-muted keep 4.5:1+ on it in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: New-tab greeting and empty states. One per screen, italic, in ink.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles on internal pages (Settings, Downloads, History).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings in Settings and dialogs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Selected tab title, button labels, menu item emphasis.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Tab titles, menu items, settings copy. The default text of all chrome.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Secondary rows, toggles' labels, toast text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the sidebar and Command Center. ink-muted.

styles.name: url
styles.usage: URLs in the address pill and Command Center results, kbd keys, download sizes.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a focus ring and its control; icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked sidebar tabs; icon-to-badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; padding inside kbd and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of tabs, menu rows and buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sidebar inner padding; Command Center padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sidebar groups; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Settings section spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: New-tab page margins; the greeting's breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd keys, tags, favicon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs, menu rows, quiet and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The web-page card, context menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Command Center and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Address pill, primary buttons, toggles, workspace dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The web-page card sitting on bg-void.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Command Center, context menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: dur-tremor
tokens.usage: The zitter tremor: two 1px shakes when something lands (new tab, copied URL). Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover and press fills.

tokens.name: dur-move
tokens.usage: Panels opening, the sidebar sliding, split view resizing.
